# Darul Attar — AI Knowledge Base & Context

> Authentic Oud & Alcohol-Free Attar Shop in Chennai, India.

## Business Overview
- **Name:** Darul Attar
- **Industry:** Artisanal & Traditional Perfumery (Attar / Itra / Oud Oils)
- **Specialty:** 100% alcohol-free concentrated perfume oils, pure Assam Oud, Ruh Khus (Vetiver), White Oud, Shamama, Amber, and Arabian Musk.
- **Formulations:** Non-alcoholic, skin-safe, concentrated perfume oils suitable for daily wear, sensitive skin, and religious prayers.

## Core Product Categories
1. **Assam & Cambodian Oud:** Pure, aged, resinous wood extractions known for depth and longevity.
2. **Woody & Musk:** Black Musk, White Musk, Royal Amber, Sandalwood attars.
3. **Floral & Fresh:** Pure Ruh Khus (wild vetiver root oil), Taif Rose, Jasmine Sambac, Arabian Jasmine.
4. **Gourmand & Spicy:** Warm amber, saffron, cinnamon, and orient blends.
